title: Discovery → Jira Agent
summary: From a messy client call to reviewed Jira tickets — every requirement traced back to the transcript.
problem: Requirements get lost between the discovery call and the backlog, and contradictions with the spec surface too late.
solution: A LangGraph agent extracts requirements with verbatim quotes, checks them against the project spec via RAG (new / duplicate / conflict / unclear), writes user stories, and a human approves before idempotent Jira writes.
result: In progress — target: evals with a pass threshold in CI, traces and cost per run, and a dry-run Jira preview for the public demo.
